# AXIOM 4.0 Parliamentary Debate Tournament

> AXIOM 4.0 is SMVIT DebSoc's annual collegiate debate tournament held at Sir M. Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology (Sir MVIT) in Bengaluru, India.

## Tournament Details
- **Organiser**: SMVIT Debating Society (SMVIT DebSoc)
- **Website**: https://www.axiom4.online
- **Official Host Society**: https://www.smvitdebsoc.com
- **Venue**: Sir M. Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology, Krishnadevarayanagar, Hunasamaranahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562157
- **Format**: Parliamentary Debate (3v3 Asian / 2v2 BP format)
- **Registration**: Online registration via Google Authentication on https://www.axiom4.online

## Key Endpoints & Architecture
- **Home / Registration**: https://www.axiom4.online/
- **About the Tournament**: https://www.axiom4.online/about
- **Participant Workspace**: https://www.axiom4.online/dashboard
- **Live Matchups & Standings**: https://www.axiom4.online/dashboard/events
- **Real-time Engine**: WebSockets via Socket.io with HTTP polling fallback
